en: Black‑and‑white view of a walled courtyard or inner bailey of a large stone castle or fortress. The scene is lined with tall, pruned trees along a broad path leading toward an arched gateway set in a Renaissance or Baroque portal on the far wall. High, steeply pitched, tiled roofs with small dormers and irregularly spaced windows top the thick masonry walls. A few men in early 20th‑century attire stand and talk on the path, giving a peaceful, park‑like impression inside the castle complex.
